title: Pouring Water for Supper

readiness.math: judging an amount by eye; halves and quarters (older)

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Supper needs water to drink. Here is a jug, and three glasses with a little line on each.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hold the jug over a glass to pour. Watch the water rise, and let go when it reaches the line.

older.prompt: Fill each glass to its line: three quarters, half, and a quarter.

steps.prompt: Fill each glass to its line. Hold the jug over a glass, and let go at the line.

feedback.all_good: Every glass is filled to its line, and not a drop spilled.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The water is poured. Careful hands make a welcome table.

journal_line: I poured water for supper, stopping each glass at its line.
unavailable_text: The water is already poured for today.
